query_text: Imagine that instead of presidential debates, we had rap battles. Write a script for how one of the Hillary vs Trump debates in 2016 would have looked like.

parts.text:
**Title:** The Battle for the Oval: Hofstra Showdown (2016)
**Setting:** A dimly lit arena at Hofstra University. Instead of podiums, there is a central boxing-style ring with two microphones on stands. The crowd is roaring. 

**Moderator/Hypeman:** Lester Holt (wearing a sleek suit, holding a gold microphone)

---

### **[INTRO]**

**LESTER HOLT:**
(Walking to the center of the ring, mic to his mouth)
*Yeah! Check, check, one-two!*
Welcome to the main event, live from New York!
Tonight we don’t want talking points, we don’t want small talk!
We got two heavyweights ready to go toe-to-toe,
Four years of the future decided by this show!
No podiums, no policy papers, just the mic,
Spitting bars about the country and the things they dislike.
In the red corner—the mogul from Queens, the master of the spin...
**DONALD TRUMP!**

*(The crowd erupts. Trump walks out, doing his signature double-fist pump, wearing a red tie. He grabs the mic, nodding confidently.)*

**LESTER HOLT:**
And in the blue corner—the former First Lady, Senator, Secretary of State...
**HILLARY CLINTON!**

*(Hillary walks out in a bright red pantsuit, smiling warmly, waving, doing a brief, slightly awkward shoulder shimmy before grabbing her mic.)*

**LESTER HOLT:**
The coin toss went to Trump. Donald, you got the first round. Two minutes on the clock. 
DJ, drop the beat!

*(A heavy, classic boom-bap beat drops: deep bass, sharp snare.)*

---

### **[ROUND 1: DONALD TRUMP]**

**TRUMP:**
*(Rhythmical, conversational, aggressive delivery)*
Yeah. Look at this. Very sad. Very slow.
I’m gonna spit some truth that the media won’t show.
Hillary, you’ve been doing this for thirty long years,
And all you’ve given the people is taxes and tears!
You’re a typical politician—all talk, no action,
Your campaign is running on a fractions of a fraction!
Look at your emails—thirty thousand, deleted!
If I did that, the system would have me defeated!
You set up a server in your basement, elite,
While the working-class people are starved on the street.
Your husband signed NAFTA—a total disaster,
Sending our manufacturing jobs away faster!
Now Mexico’s winning, and China is too,
And the Rust Belt is rusted because of *you*.
You’ve got no stamina, you’re weak, you’re low-key,
You fainted in September—couldn't handle the heat!
I’m a self-made billionaire, I build and I win,
When I’m in the White House, the greatness begins!
We’re gonna build a wall, it’ll be beautiful and tall,
And we’ll make Mexico pay for it all! *Wrong!*

*(Trump points at Hillary, drops his mic to his side, and smugly sways to the beat. The crowd goes wild.)*

---

### **[ROUND 1 REBUTTAL: HILLARY CLINTON]**

**HILLARY:**
*(Calculated, sharp, slightly rehearsed but delivering each syllable with precision)*
Well, Lester, it’s clear Donald lives in a bubble,
Where his facts are make-believe and his business is in trouble.
You talk about winning, but let’s look at the facts:
You’re the only nominee who won’t show us his tax!
What are you hiding? Are you not quite as rich?
Or did you stiff the little guy to scratch your own itch?
Six bankruptcies, Donald! You went totally bust,
But you want the American Treasury to trust?
You stiffed the contractors, the painters, the crew,
If you ran the country, we’d be bankrupt too!
And let’s talk about your temperament—it's totally wild,
You tweet at three a.m. like an angry, spoiled child.
A man you can bait with a single little tweet
Is not a man we can trust in the Commander-in-Chief seat!
I’ve been in the Situation Room, making the call,
While you were hosting *The Apprentice*, fired 'em all!
You want to make America great? Start with your brand,
Your ties are made in China, not in this land! 

*(Hillary smiles, does a slight mic-flip gesture. The crowd goes "OOOOOOH!")*

---

### **[ROUND 2: DONALD TRUMP]**

**LESTER HOLT:**
Round two! The beat changes! 
*(The DJ transitions to a faster, trap-style beat with heavy hi-hats.)*
Donald, you're up!

**TRUMP:**
*(Leaning into the mic, riding the trap beat with staccato phrasing)*
China! China! That’s all she can say!
Because her donors in Wall Street are paying her way!
You gave secret speeches to Goldman Sachs,
I’m the voice of the forgotten—and those are the facts.
You called my supporters "deplorable," a basket of shame?
That’s why you’re losing this election game!
Look at the Middle East, a total disaster zone,
You and Obama left Iraq all alone.
You drew a red line, then you drew it in pencil,
Now ISIS is spreading with a brand new credential.
You’re a disaster on foreign policy, Libya’s crying,
But you stand on the stage and you just keep on lying.
I’m the law-and-order candidate, I’ll clean up the streets,
While you’re pandering for votes with your fake receipts.
I don't need a teleprompter, I speak from the heart,
Your entire career, Hillary, is falling apart!
*Sad!*

*(Trump shakes his head, mugging for the camera.)*

---

### **[ROUND 2 REBUTTAL: HILLARY CLINTON]**

**HILLARY:**
*(Stepping forward, locking eyes with Trump, flow getting faster and more aggressive)*
You talk about law and order, but you mock the police,
You praise foreign dictators and threaten the peace.
You insulted Gold Star families, the heroes who fell,
And you think Russian hacking is going to go well?
"Russia, if you're listening"—that's what you said!
You’re a puppet for Putin, you’re in over your head!
And let’s talk about women, the things that you say,
You rate them on numbers, you treat them like clay.
"Nasty woman," "pig," "dog"—the list goes on and on,
But you’ll see our power when your movement is gone.
I fought for healthcare, for children, for years,
While you sued your tenants and fed off their fears.
We are stronger together, that's the dream we pursue,
We don't need a reality star running the crew.
So pack up your spray tan, your towers of gold,
Because your divisive act is getting incredibly old!

*(Hillary finishes with a confident nod, dropping the mic into the stand with a sharp *clack*.)*

---

### **[OUTRO]**

**LESTER HOLT:**
*(Stepping between them as the beat fades out)*
*OH!* The bars have been dropped! The fire has been spit!
The mic is still smoking, and the stage is still lit!
Who had the flow? Who had the facts?
Who’s going to Washington, and who's packing their sacks?
Voters of America, the choice is with you,
On November 8th, what you gonna do?
This has been the 2016 Presidential Rap Debate!
Goodnight!

*(The crowd goes absolutely wild as Trump and Hillary refuse to shake hands, staring each other down as the credits roll.)*
